# Policy lists

<!-- generated by tests/policy_tables.py from the source; edit the source, then run it with --write -->

The exact lists appjail enforces, taken from its source when this page was generated. Why each exists is
explained on the page linked under each heading.

## Paths that are never granted

Explained in [the filesystem view](../understand/isolation/filesystem.md). Paths below the home directory
are written without `~/`; a folder that contains one of the secret paths is refused too.

| Refused | In every mode | Read-write only |
|---|---|---|
| credentials and secrets (`grants.SECRET_HOME_DIRS`) | `.ssh`, `.gnupg`, `.aws`, `.kube`, `.docker`, `.password-store`, `.netrc`, `.config/gcloud`, `.config/gh`, `.config/Bitwarden`, `.local/share/keyrings`, `.local/share/gnome-keyring`, `.git-credentials`, `.pki`, `.bash_history`, `.zsh_history`, `.zhistory`, `.python_history`, `.lesshst`, `.psql_history`, `.mysql_history`, `.node_repl_history`, `.local/share/fish`, `.mozilla`, `.thunderbird`, `.mail`, `.gnupg2`, `.var`, `.config/google-chrome`, `.config/chromium`, `.config/BraveSoftware`, `.config/vivaldi`, `.config/microsoft-edge`, `.config/opera`, `.config/mozilla`, `.cache/mozilla`, `.local/share/kwalletd`, `.local/share/Trash`, `.npmrc`, `.yarnrc`, `.yarnrc.yml`, `.pypirc`, `.cargo/credentials`, `.cargo/credentials.toml`, `.gem/credentials`, `.m2/settings.xml`, `.gradle/gradle.properties`, `.config/rclone`, `.azure`, `.oci`, `.config/doctl`, `.config/hub`, `.config/glab-cli`, `.terraform.d`, `.config/op`, `.config/1Password`, `.1password`, `.config/keepassxc`, `.local/share/keepassxc`, `.config/KeePass`, `.config/Signal` | |
| file names like keys and password databases (`grants.SECRET_SUFFIXES`) | `*.kdbx`, `*.kdb`, `*.key`, `*.pem`, `*.p12`, `*.pfx` | |
| too broad (`grants.BROAD_HOME_DIRS`) | `.config`, `.local`, `.local/share`, `.local/state`, `.cache`, the home directory and its parents, `/` | |
| system trees (`grants.SYSTEM_PATHS`) | `/etc`, `/dev`, `/proc`, `/sys`, `/run`, `/boot`, `/root`, `/usr`, `/bin`, `/sbin`, `/lib`, `/lib32`, `/lib64` | |
| shared temporary directories, as folders (`grants.SHARED_DIRS`) | `/tmp`, `/var/tmp` | |
| code that runs outside the jail later (`grants.PERSIST_HOME_DIRS`) | | `.local/bin`, `.config/autostart`, `.config/systemd`, `.config/environment.d`, `.config/fish`, `.local/share/applications`, `.local/share/systemd`, `.local/share/dbus-1`, `.bashrc.d`, `.profile.d`, `.config/plasma-workspace`, `.config/Code`, `.config/nvim`, `.config/zsh`, `.local/lib`, `.local/share/thumbnailers`, `.local/share/kio/servicemenus`, `.local/share/kservices5`, `.local/share/nautilus/scripts`, `.local/share/nemo/actions`, `.local/share/nemo/scripts`, `.local/share/icons`, `.icons` |
| startup files (`grants.PERSIST_HOME_FILES`) | | `.bashrc`, `.bash_profile`, `.bash_login`, `.bash_logout`, `.profile`, `.zshrc`, `.zshenv`, `.zprofile`, `.zlogin`, `.xprofile`, `.xinitrc`, `.xsession`, `.xsessionrc`, `.pam_environment`, `.gitconfig`, `.npmrc`, `.pypirc`, `.netrc`, `.vimrc`, `.config/git/config` |
| the look of your other apps (`grants.APPEARANCE_HOME_DIRS`) | | `.config/gtk-2.0`, `.gtkrc-2.0`, `.config/gtk-3.0`, `.config/gtk-4.0`, `.local/share/themes`, `.themes`, `.config/fontconfig`, `.local/share/fonts`, `.fonts`, `.config/kdeglobals`, `.config/qt5ct`, `.config/qt6ct`, `.config/Kvantum` |

## D-Bus names

Explained in [D-Bus and the filtering proxy](../understand/desktop/dbus.md).

| List | Names |
|---|---|
| refused, with every name below them (`grants.DBUS_BLOCKED`) | `org.freedesktop.DBus`, `org.freedesktop.systemd1`, `org.freedesktop.Flatpak`, `org.freedesktop.impl`, `org.gnome.Shell`, `org.gnome.SessionManager`, `org.kde.KWin`, `org.kde.klauncher5`, `org.kde.klauncher6`, `org.freedesktop.portal`, `ca.desrt.dconf`, `org.gtk.vfs`, `org.gnome.Mutter`, `org.freedesktop.a11y`, `org.gnome.ScreenSaver`, `org.kde.kglobalaccel`, `org.kde.keyboard`, `org.cinnamon.Muffin`, `org.Cinnamon`, `org.kde.plasmashell`, `org.kde.klipper` |
| allowed with a warning: stored secrets (`grants.DBUS_SENSITIVE`) | `org.freedesktop.secrets`, `org.gnome.keyring`, `org.kde.kwalletd5`, `org.kde.kwalletd6` |
| cannot be owned (`grants.DBUS_NO_OWN`) | `org.freedesktop.*`, `org.gnome.*`, `org.kde.*`, `org.a11y.*`, `com.canonical.*`, `org.ayatana.*`, `org.gtk.*`, `ca.desrt.*` |
| may be owned all the same (`grants.DBUS_OWN_OK`) | `org.freedesktop.StatusNotifierItem*`, `org.kde.StatusNotifierItem*` |
| a wildcard needs at least | 3 name parts before `.*` |

Confined services (`dbusproxy.CONFINED`): only these interfaces, on this object path, plus `org.freedesktop.DBus.Properties`, `org.freedesktop.DBus.Introspectable`, `org.freedesktop.DBus.Peer`.

| Name | Interfaces | Object path |
|---|---|---|
| `org.freedesktop.Notifications` | `org.freedesktop.Notifications` | `/org/freedesktop/Notifications` |
| `org.gtk.Notifications` | `org.gtk.Notifications` | `/org/gtk/Notifications` |
| `org.freedesktop.secrets` | `org.freedesktop.Secret.Service`, `org.freedesktop.Secret.Collection`, `org.freedesktop.Secret.Item`, `org.freedesktop.Secret.Session`, `org.freedesktop.Secret.Prompt` | `/org/freedesktop/secrets/*` |
| `org.kde.StatusNotifierWatcher` | `org.kde.StatusNotifierWatcher` | `/StatusNotifierWatcher` |
| `org.mpris.MediaPlayer2.*` | `org.mpris.MediaPlayer2`, `org.mpris.MediaPlayer2.Player`, `org.mpris.MediaPlayer2.TrackList`, `org.mpris.MediaPlayer2.Playlists` | `/org/mpris/MediaPlayer2` |

## Portal interfaces

Explained in [portals](../understand/desktop/portals.md). Names are the part after `org.freedesktop.portal.`.

| Set | Interfaces |
|---|---|
| with `portals = true` (`grants.PORTAL_SAFE`), plus the document portal | `FileChooser`, `Notification`, `Settings`, `Trash`, `Print`, `Inhibit`, `NetworkMonitor`, `ProxyResolver`, `Secret`, `Realtime`, `MemoryMonitor`, `PowerProfileMonitor` |
| opt-in, named in `portal_interfaces` (`grants.PORTAL_OPT_IN`) | `OpenURI`, `Email`, `Screenshot`, `ScreenCast`, `RemoteDesktop`, `GlobalShortcuts`, `InputCapture`, `Camera`, `Location`, `Account`, `Wallpaper`, `Background`, `Usb` |
| never (`grants.PORTAL_NEVER`) | `Flatpak`, `DynamicLauncher` |
| permission-store tables cleared by `remove` (`portal.STORE_TABLES`) | `background`, `desktop-used-apps`, `devices`, `gamemode`, `global-shortcuts`, `inhibit`, `input-capture`, `location`, `notifications`, `realtime`, `remote-desktop`, `screencast`, `screenshot`, `usb`, `wallpaper` |

## Wayland interfaces

Explained in [Wayland](../understand/desktop/wayland.md). A socket that lists a privileged interface, or one
in neither list, refuses a windowed app without `full_wayland`.

| Privileged kind | Lets a client | Interfaces |
|---|---|---|
| capture | capture the screen | `zwlr_screencopy_manager_v1`, `ext_image_copy_capture_manager_v1`, `zwlr_export_dmabuf_manager_v1`, `hyprland_toplevel_export_manager_v1`, `zkde_screencast_unstable_v1`, `weston_capture_v1` |
| input | type or click for other apps, or take over the keyboard | `zwlr_virtual_pointer_manager_v1`, `zwp_virtual_keyboard_manager_v1`, `zwp_input_method_manager_v2`, `zwp_input_method_v1`, `zwp_input_panel_v1`, `org_kde_kwin_fake_input`, `zwlr_input_inhibit_manager_v1`, `hyprland_global_shortcuts_manager_v1`, `zwf_shell_manager_v2`, `ext_transient_seat_manager_v1`, `hyprland_focus_grab_manager_v1` |
| clipboard | read and replace the clipboard without having the focus | `zwlr_data_control_manager_v1`, `ext_data_control_manager_v1` |
| windows | see or control other apps' windows, the screen layout or the lock screen | `zwlr_foreign_toplevel_manager_v1`, `ext_foreign_toplevel_list_v1`, `org_kde_plasma_window_management`, `zwlr_layer_shell_v1`, `org_kde_plasma_shell`, `weston_desktop_shell`, `zwlr_output_manager_v1`, `zwlr_output_power_manager_v1`, `zwlr_gamma_control_manager_v1`, `kde_output_management_v2`, `kde_output_management_v1`, `ext_session_lock_manager_v1`, `ext_workspace_manager_v1`, `zcosmic_workspace_manager_v1`, `hyprland_toplevel_mapping_manager_v1`, `hyprland_ctm_control_manager_v1`, `hyprland_lock_notifier_v1` |
| desktop | switch the screens off, change their brightness, the virtual desktops or the screen edges, or read the lock keys | `org_kde_kwin_dpms_manager`, `kde_external_brightness_v1`, `org_kde_plasma_virtual_desktop_management`, `kde_screen_edge_manager_v1`, `org_kde_kwin_keystate` |

Allowed (`wayland.ALLOWED`): `ext_foreign_toplevel_image_capture_source_manager_v1`, `ext_idle_notifier_v1`, `ext_output_image_capture_source_manager_v1`, `frog_color_management_factory_v1`, `gtk_primary_selection_device_manager`, `gtk_shell1`, `gtk_text_input_manager`, `hyprland_surface_manager_v1`, `kde_output_device_v2`, `kde_output_order_v1`, `org_kde_kwin_appmenu_manager`, `org_kde_kwin_idle`, `org_kde_kwin_server_decoration_manager`, `org_kde_kwin_server_decoration_palette_manager`, `org_kde_kwin_shadow_manager`, `wl_compositor`, `wl_data_device_manager`, `wl_drm`, `wl_fixes`, `wl_output`, `wl_seat`, `wl_shell`, `wl_shm`, `wl_subcompositor`, `wp_alpha_modifier_v1`, `wp_color_manager_v1`, `wp_color_representation_manager_v1`, `wp_commit_timing_manager_v1`, `wp_content_type_manager_v1`, `wp_cursor_shape_manager_v1`, `wp_drm_lease_device_v1`, `wp_fifo_manager_v1`, `wp_fractional_scale_manager_v1`, `wp_linux_drm_syncobj_manager_v1`, `wp_pointer_warp_v1`, `wp_presentation`, `wp_security_context_manager_v1`, `wp_single_pixel_buffer_manager_v1`, `wp_tearing_control_manager_v1`, `wp_viewporter`, `xdg_activation_v1`, `xdg_system_bell_v1`, `xdg_toplevel_drag_manager_v1`, `xdg_toplevel_icon_manager_v1`, `xdg_toplevel_tag_manager_v1`, `xdg_wm_base`, `xdg_wm_dialog_v1`, `xwayland_shell_v1`, `zwp_idle_inhibit_manager_v1`, `zwp_input_timestamps_manager_v1`, `zwp_keyboard_shortcuts_inhibit_manager_v1`, `zwp_linux_dmabuf_v1`, `zwp_linux_explicit_synchronization_v1`, `zwp_pointer_constraints_v1`, `zwp_pointer_gestures_v1`, `zwp_primary_selection_device_manager_v1`, `zwp_relative_pointer_manager_v1`, `zwp_tablet_manager_v2`, `zwp_text_input_manager_v1`, `zwp_text_input_manager_v2`, `zwp_text_input_manager_v3`, `zxdg_decoration_manager_v1`, `zxdg_exporter_v1`, `zxdg_exporter_v2`, `zxdg_importer_v1`, `zxdg_importer_v2`, `zxdg_output_manager_v1`, `zxdg_shell_v6`.

## System calls

Explained in [seccomp](../understand/isolation/seccomp.md).

| Rule | System calls |
|---|---|
| always refused, `EPERM` (`seccomp.ALWAYS`) | `_sysctl`, `acct`, `add_key`, `bpf`, `create_module`, `delete_module`, `fanotify_init`, `finit_module`, `get_kernel_syms`, `get_mempolicy`, `init_module`, `ioperm`, `iopl`, `kexec_file_load`, `kexec_load`, `keyctl`, `lookup_dcookie`, `mbind`, `migrate_pages`, `move_pages`, `name_to_handle_at`, `nfsservctl`, `open_by_handle_at`, `perf_event_open`, `process_vm_readv`, `process_vm_writev`, `ptrace`, `query_module`, `quotactl`, `reboot`, `request_key`, `set_mempolicy`, `swapoff`, `swapon`, `syslog`, `uselib`, `userfaultfd` |
| `ioctl` refused, `EPERM` | `TIOCSTI`, `TIOCLINUX` |
| `socket`, `socketpair`: only these families, else `EAFNOSUPPORT` | `AF_UNSPEC`, `AF_UNIX`, `AF_INET`, `AF_INET6`, `AF_NETLINK` |
| `personality`: only the default and the query, else `EPERM` | `PER_LINUX`, `0xffffffff` |
| answered `ENOSYS` (`seccomp.IO_URING`) | `io_uring_enter`, `io_uring_register`, `io_uring_setup` |
| refused without `userns`, `EPERM` (`seccomp.NAMESPACE`) | `chroot`, `fsconfig`, `fsmount`, `fsopen`, `fspick`, `mount`, `mount_setattr`, `move_mount`, `open_tree`, `pivot_root`, `setns`, `umount2`, `unshare`, `clone` with a new-namespace flag; `clone3` answers `ENOSYS` |
| any architecture but x86-64, the x32 ABI | process killed / `EPERM` |
